patterns.note: A fixed-width, multi-column grid layout reminiscent of early web design, with content segmented into distinct, bordered rectangular panels.
A deliberate mix of a large, pixelated display font for the main branding and a standard system sans-serif for body text, creating a lo-fi, retro aesthetic.
A predominantly monochrome palette of black, white, and various shades of light grey, with minimal, high-contrast accent colors used sparingly for links and specific labels.

A multi-layered scrolling effect where a fixed header (including the main title and intro text) remains in place while the central content area scrolls underneath it. A specific text element on the right changes its content ('OPE' to 'SORRY') at a defined scroll point, and a contact email address is revealed progressively as the user scrolls.
Content is organized into clearly delineated, bordered sections, each functioning as a self-contained widget or content block (e.g., drawing canvas, clock, work links).

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that keeps the main title and introductory text visible at the top of the viewport. The primary content area scrolls beneath this fixed header. Additionally, a text element dynamically changes its content based on scroll position, and a contact email address is revealed incrementally through a scroll-triggered horizontal reveal effect, appearing to slide into view from behind a mask. The interactive drawing area is implemented using a canvas element.

The overall layout is achieved using a fixed-width container centered on the page, with internal content organized into a grid of bordered divs, mimicking a table-based layout from older web design paradigms.

design_tokens.type_scale: A very large, pixelated display font (~4-5x body) contrasts with small, standard sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, with all corners at 90-degree angles across all elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Dense within individual content panels, but balanced between the large, distinct panels, creating an overall packed yet organized feel.

standout: This site's most distinctive feature is its deliberate embrace of a retro, early-internet aesthetic, combining pixel art, hand-drawn elements, a fixed-width table-like layout, and interactive widgets (like the drawing canvas and dynamic text) to create a highly personal and quirky online presence that defies modern design conventions.
